Can each of you walk me through where your reviews stand?

This means the release must be licensed under AGPL-3.0-only, and we must provide the corresponding source for the linked toolkit code. I have the full dependency analysis in my release-gate working papers. This is my finding for the open-source portion of the release gate.

I have the record-level review retained in my privacy workpapers pending this approval meeting.
